race.description: Ronald Mcdonald House Vic/Tas Trophy Hcp
race.comment: Tricky finish. STORM LEOPARD (13) will need a good ride but put the writing on the wall first up with a nice return over 1400m at Caulfield, getting home strongly for fifth. That was always going to be too sharp so the step to 1700m is ideal with 54kg, if Williams can be positive early and slot in somewhere from the wide gate he'll go close. JUSTADEEL (9) was well backed second up at Sandown Hillside over 1500m in a strange race on heavy ground. He did keep coming on the line despite being well beaten and third up to 1700m from a lovely draw should suit nicely now. FUTURE HISTORY (1) resumes, big weight but only off 11 weeks and he's good enough. Could be the blowout up on speed. SUNTORA (8) worth including at odds.
